page.overview:
Who is Monoid?

Ingrid's true form resides within a higher dimension that can't be comprehended within the human world. As such, her human-like body is actually a projection of this transcendent form. During this projection, any leftover energy that is unable to fit within her physical body are distorted and become Monoids.

Monoids resemble super-deformed versions of Ingrid while also taking a similar shape to Japanese [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Teru_teru_bōzu Teru-teru bōzu] dolls, talismans which are hung outside to encourage sunny weather. They can also appear in different colors besides the typical blue attire and red eyes.

Due to sharing Ingrid's playful and snarky nature, Monoids often disobey her to run off and cause mischief within the human world. They also share Ingrid's habit of breaking the forth wall.

During World Tour mode, after stumbling into an uninhabited alternate universe of Nayshall, the Avatar catches a Monoid, summoning Ingrid. Ingrid reveals this interaction with the Monoid has linked the Avatar's fate to herself and tells them to seek out additional Monoids in order to maintain contact with her.
